svg.title: ThinkCoder orchestration
svg.desc: Animated diagram: each problem gets its own LangGraph session, LiteLLM sends easy requests to a local Qwen model on Ollama and hard ones to Gemini, and long sessions are trimmed to fit the context window.

g.text: problem 1: easy → local Qwen2.5-Coder-7B on Ollama
problem 2: easy → local Qwen2.5-Coder-7B on Ollama
problem 3: hard → Gemini in the cloud
problem 4: easy → local Qwen2.5-Coder-7B on Ollama
